title: Invite by email from the same bar; a Sefaria user is told in Social, anyone else gets an email with the room's link

tasks.title: Email invitations through the Sefaria lookup and the email provider

acs.text: WHEN an invitation's entry is an email address and the account lookup is configured THE SYSTEM SHALL ask Sefaria (`POST <SEFARIA_LOOKUP_URL>`, the body signed like the deletion webhook) which account has that address; for an account it SHALL add the same `room_invite` notification as a handle does, with no email
scenarios: AC-001 an address with an account

acs.text: WHEN no Sefaria account has the address, or the lookup is not configured, THE SYSTEM SHALL send one email to it through the email provider, saying who invited them, the room's title and its link, with every value escaped, at most once per room and address in 24 hours
scenarios: AC-002 an address without an account

acs.text: THE SYSTEM SHALL answer an email entry `invited` whether or not an account has that address (the answer never tells the caller who has an account), and SHALL keep no email address: only its SHA-256, to apply the 24-hour rule
scenarios: AC-003 no telling who has an account

acs.text: WHILE no email provider key is set THE SYSTEM SHALL answer every email entry `unavailable` without looking it up, and the bar SHALL say that inviting by email is not available here; handles work as before
WHEN the lookup or the provider fails or takes more than 10 seconds THE SYSTEM SHALL answer that entry `failed`, the others unaffected, and log it without the address
